expectations.text: Checks that every fee instrument names its collection mechanism, its enforcement pair, and its notice commitment in writing

expectations.text: Checks that the published developer docs state the end-to-end sale-to-bank timeline and the jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction tax split

expectations.evidence: Dashboard items 1-5 cover tax per jurisdiction and registration coverage, net take minus ops cost, median sale-to-bank days, dispute/refund rate by owner, waiver coverage and circumvention.
